outcome: pain scores at rest and activity (VAS scores)
cohort: 120 women undergoing caesarean delivery under general anesthesia were randomized into a TAP block group (n=60) or a control group (n=60).
finding: Ultrasound-guided TAP block provided better analgesic effect, reduced morphine consumption, and decreased side effects after caesarean section compared to no TAP block.
mod_finding: The study found that ultrasound-guided TAP block improved pain relief and reduced side effects specifically for women who underwent caesarean section.
